It seems the actual instruction is "Delete" — perhaps delete the existing game? Hmm. In this benchmark context, probably user asks to "Delete" and then generic build request. Need inspect workspace. Maybe there's an existing game and request is to delete it? But then "build a complete, playable game now" contradicts. Maybe "Delete" is title/name of a game? Could be a game called "Delete" to build. Repeated messages identical. We need build a game.
